mapper.insert: insert into voya_ai_comment (user_id, target_type, target_id, parent_id, content, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, target_type, target_id, parent_id, content, like_count, del_flag, create_time from voya_ai_comment where id = #{id}

select c.id, c.user_id, c.target_type, c.target_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, case c.target_type when 'attraction' then a.name when 'guide' then g.title end as target_title, pc.content as parent_content, pu.nickname as parent_nickname from voya_ai_comment c left join voya_ai_user u on c.user_id = u.id left join voya_ai_attraction a on c.target_type = 'attraction' and c.target_id = a.id left join voya_ai_guide g on c.target_type = 'guide' and c.target_id = g.id left join voya_ai_comment pc on c.parent_id > 0 and pc.id = c.parent_id left join voya_ai_user pu on pc.user_id = pu.id where c.id = #{id} and c.del_flag = '0'

select c.id, c.user_id, c.target_type, c.target_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar_url from voya_ai_comment c left join voya_ai_user u on c.user_id = u.id where c.target_type = #{targetType} and c.target_id = #{targetId} and c.parent_id = 0 and c.del_flag = '0' order by c.create_time desc, c.id desc

select c.id, c.user_id, c.target_type, c.target_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar_url from voya_ai_comment c left join voya_ai_user u on c.user_id = u.id where c.parent_id in #{pid} and c.del_flag = '0' order by c.create_time asc, c.id asc

select c.id, c.user_id, c.target_type, c.target_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar_url from voya_ai_comment c left join voya_ai_user u on c.user_id = u.id where c.parent_id = #{parentId} and c.del_flag = '0' order by c.create_time asc, c.id asc
mapper.update: update voya_ai_comment set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update voya_ai_comment set del_flag = '1' where parent_id = #{parentId} and del_flag = '0'
update voya_ai_comment set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'

choose.when: select count(*) from voya_ai_attraction where id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0'
choose.otherwise: select count(*) from voya_ai_guide where id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0'

mapper.select: select target_id from voya_ai_like where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = 'comment' and target_id in #{cid}
